description.value: Make a ranged gunblade Strike with a range increment of 30 feet and a maximum range of 120 feet. Use Dexterity for the attack. Deal fire damage using the gunblade's one-handed base damage die and its runes; add specialization normally, but do not add Strength to damage. This does not consume a cartridge or require reloading. Normal ranged attack rules, including cover, multiple attack penalty, and reactions, apply. It does not advance a combo or grant Continuation. Roll the attack and damage manually; the melee weapon entry is not converted automatically.
